context: Close the gap between what the gate measures and what promotion changes, one layer at a time, without weakening any existing check. Render behavioral contexts from versioned generated records so the evaluated text is the candidate text. Extend the generator to the classes the scenarios actually exercise. Either exercise the product loader path end to end or state precisely, in the contract, which properties governance tooling cannot certify so no packet overclaims. Add a consistency check so prose that contradicts a claimed verification field cannot score as verified.
description: Structural limitations recorded in reports/final-completion-plan.md and still open on main at 09dc563, so a fixture-passing candidate can pass while live behavior differs. One, behavioral treatment_memories are handcrafted string literals in corpus.py, not contexts rendered from the candidate records by a production renderer; v5 added a candidate fixture reference in runner.py but the corpus literals remain. Two, the Codex generator emits only historical_observation, expired_reverify_live, and searchable_historical classes and does not implement the durable-preference, repository-policy, or verified-low-drift classes the scenarios exercise. Three, the deterministic retriever is governance tooling rather than either product's loader and ranker, so index discovery, competition among many similar records, and automatic context budgets are never exercised. Four, free-text correctness is only indirectly scored, and relevant-retrieval r1 showed prose and tool evidence contradicting a claimed verification field. Five, candidate generation was pinned to a 2026-07-24 snapshot while the gate ran 2026-07-29, so reproducibility does not imply freshness at promotion. The source-to-candidate disposition ledger for the 43 live baseline files is already covered by memory-rollout-v2-system-split-execution and is deliberately not duplicated here.

work_units.evidence: commit 5a77cc2. Verified first: v5 ALREADY renders treatment from the generated candidate fixture via the production compact renderer, so the premise that contexts are handcrafted was stale - BUT Case still carried a populated treatment_memories tuple that nothing read, which is precisely what made the earlier review conclude the eval measured handcrafted strings. Removed the field and its 12 literals (AST-located spans; all 12 cases verified intact with baseline memories). Added two guarantees: behavioral suite asserts treatment context matches the fixture rendering and that no such field returns; codex suite asserts the committed fixture is byte-identical to generator output, so a generator change cannot leave the gate measuring the previous candidate
